tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active developer jobs. Returns compact JobSpecs (no description) sorted by relevance or recency. Use get_job for details.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full JobSpec for one job, including the employer's description as untrusted_description.

tools.name: similar_jobs
tools.description: Roles similar to a given job (title, stack and description overlap), excluding the same role at other locations.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Natural-language job search, e.g. 'remote senior Rust jobs in Europe'. Understands salary floors ('over €120k') and exclusions ('no crypto'). Returns ids, titles and URLs, the total, filters: how the query was read (as search_jobs arguments), and broadened: filters it dropped to find any results. Us

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text and metadata for one job id returned by search.

tools.name: salary_insights
tools.description: Yearly salary percentiles per currency for active jobs matching the filters, from employer-published ranges.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Companies in the index with their number of active developer jobs.

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: Totals and the most requested technologies across all active jobs.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
